header.spracheNichtGespeichert: {{sprache}} applies now, but it could not be saved to your account. Click {{kuerzel}} again to retry.

nichtGefunden.text: This address does not exist. The link may be out of date.

anmeldung.einleitung: Please sign in with your account. Accounts are created by the administrators; there is no self-registration.

demo.hinweis: Everyone with the link shares this demo. Please do not enter real data.

sitzung.abgelaufen: Your session has expired. Please sign in again, and you will carry on where you left off.

fehler.netzwerk: The server cannot be reached. You may not be connected right now. Please check your internet connection and try again in a moment.
fehler.unlesbar: The server gave an unexpected answer. Please try again. If it keeps happening, please report the problem.
fehler.unbekannt: Something went wrong. Please try again, and report the problem if it keeps happening.

tabelle.beschriftung: Your protocols, most recently edited first

loeschen.text: The protocol “{{name}}” will be deleted permanently, with all its answers and attachments. This cannot be undone.

loeschfehler.titel: The protocol could not be deleted
loeschfehler.text: “{{name}}” is still there and unchanged. Please try again.

leer.text: A protocol can be filled in over several sittings. It is saved as you go and only submitted when you explicitly send it.

ladefehler.titel: Your protocols could not be loaded
ladefehler.text: The list cannot be reached right now. Your protocols are saved and will not be lost. Please try again.

einlesen.laeuftHinweis: Reading the file. For a complete protocol this takes a moment.

fehler.titel: The file could not be imported
fehler.text: The file could not be read. Please check that it is a completed Protokoll E-Befischung and try again.

keineBerechtigung.titel: This page is not for your account
keineBerechtigung.text: Accounts are managed by the administrators. If you would like an account created or changed, please contact the Fischereiforschungsstelle.

ladefehler.titel: The accounts could not be loaded
ladefehler.text: The list could not be loaded. Please try again.

keineTreffer.text: No account matches this search and status. Check the spelling, choose "All" for the status, or reset both.

leer.text: This application has no accounts yet. Use "New account" to create the first one.

felder.emailHinweis: The account signs in with this. Upper and lower case do not matter.
felder.passwortHinweis: At least 12 characters. You pass it on to the person yourself afterwards.

rollenHinweis.REGIERUNGSPRAESIDIUM: Read-only, and only for its own regional council. Choose the number below.
rollenHinweis.INTEGRATION: For another application, not for a person. An account like this cannot sign in.

fehlt.email: Please enter an email address. The account signs in with it.
fehlt.emailForm: This address has no @ or contains a space. Please check the spelling, for example name@behoerde.de.
fehlt.passwort: The password needs at least 12 characters. Please choose a longer one.
fehlt.rollen: Please tick at least one role. It decides what the account may do.
fehlt.regierungspraesidium: Please choose a regional council. An account with this role sees exactly one, and without a choice it would not be clear which.

anlegen.untertitel: The account can sign in as soon as you have created it.

fertig.weitergeben: Pass these sign-in details on to the person. The application sends no email, and nobody but you knows the password.
fertig.nurEinmal: The password is shown only here. Once you leave this page, it cannot be retrieved. Hand it over in a way that only the person themselves can read, so not by unencrypted email.
fertig.keinWechsel: The person cannot change their password themselves yet. If it is lost, or the wrong person has seen it, the administrators set a new one.

aendern.ladefehler: The account could not be loaded

keinKonto.text: There is no account at this link. The link is probably incomplete or out of date. In the user list you can find every existing account by its email address.

selbstentzug.rollen: You cannot take the Administrator role away from yourself, because you would then no longer be able to reach user administration. Please ask another person with this role to do it.

angaben.einleitung: Only what you touch here is changed. Fields you leave alone stay as they are.
angaben.unveraendert: There is nothing to save. Nothing about this account has been changed.

zugang.einleitung: A blocked account can no longer sign in. The block takes effect immediately, even if the person is signed in at that moment. Accounts are never deleted, because the protocols they submitted would otherwise lose their owner.
zugang.istAktiv: This account is active and can sign in.
zugang.istGesperrt: This account is blocked and cannot sign in.
zugang.eigenes: You cannot block your own account, because you would then no longer be able to use the application. Please ask another person with the Administrator role to do it.

frage.text: {{email}} will no longer be able to sign in, not even from a session that is already open. Protocols already submitted are kept. You can unblock the account here at any time.

passwort.einleitung: Set a new password if the person has forgotten theirs or if the wrong person has seen it. The old password then stops working.
passwort.neuHinweis: At least 12 characters. You pass it on to the person yourself afterwards.

fertig.titel: The password for {{email}} has been changed.
fertig.weitergeben: Pass these sign-in details on to the person. The application sends no email, and nobody but you knows the new password. Hand it over in a way that only the person themselves can read, so not by unencrypted email.
fertig.sitzungen: If the person is signed in right now, they stay signed in. An open session only ends by itself, after eight hours at the latest. If the password has fallen into the wrong hands, block the account in the Access section: the block takes effect immediately.
fertig.keinWechsel: The person still cannot change their password themselves. If it is lost again, the administrators set a new one.

leer.text: As soon as a protocol is sent, it appears here and can be reviewed.

keineTreffer.text: There are protocols, but none of them matches the current selection. Reset the filters to see all open protocols again.

ladefehler.titel: The review queue could not be loaded
ladefehler.text: The list cannot be reached right now. Nothing has been lost. Please try again.

keineBerechtigung.titel: The review queue is for FFS staff
keineBerechtigung.text: Your account may only see its own protocols. If you need access here, please contact the administrators.
